08-249 to end of 08-202 (floor-2).fix: Draw the 08-202 to 08-249 walk (and other category-3 walks that carry through traffic) in the bold pathway style, or simplify it into a guide. Extend portal ends onto the door footprint for doors 1996013, 1996146, 2491574 and 1996180.

The bold network stops at the 04-260 Vestibule arrival stub (-418,-269) and at the 04-237 Corridor arrival (-516,-244), where only grey or faint lines continue. The faint-join at (-480,-267) is the only drawn join between bold components of sizes 1 and 2.
04-259 Rotunda (floor-2).fix: Treat 04-259 (and the other Rotunda records 04-124, 04-329 and 04-445) as a path area for drawing and simplification, or draw category-3 walks between two portals in the bold style.
